title: About
text:
This website presents interactive disease notification-rate maps by Australian local government area.
The maps allow users to zoom, pan, and inspect notification-rate information for individual LGAs.

title: About
text:
Data interpretation
Notification rates are presented per 100,000 population. Rates based on small notification counts should be interpreted with appropriate caution.
LGAs shown in grey do not have an available notification rate.

title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus
text:
